items.title: Logsquare — intralogistics and supply-chain automation
items.description: Dubai- and Riyadh-based intralogistics business delivering conveyors, ASRS, robotics, software and controls; relevant to backend integrations, monitoring, data workflows and AI-assisted operations.
items.contact_strategy: Use the official project enquiry form with a focused software-controls or systems-integration proposal.
items.buyer_or_company_evidence: Official site states that Logsquare has operated since 2009, provides scalable intralogistics solutions and maintains offices in Dubai and Riyadh.

items.title: Green Light Logistics — Dubai freight and fulfilment
items.description: Dubai logistics operator covering freight, customs, warehousing, e-commerce fulfilment, last-mile delivery and returns; suitable for shipment, document and exception-workflow automation.
items.contact_strategy: Submit an operations-automation proposal through the official company contact page.
items.buyer_or_company_evidence: Official site describes a Dubai logistics company serving freight forwarding, warehousing, customs, value-added services and last-mile delivery.

items.title: Speed Logistics — Saudi last-mile delivery
items.description: Saudi last-mile operator supporting restaurants, retailers and enterprise teams with dispatch, rider tracking and fleet operations; relevant to API integrations and operational automation.
items.contact_strategy: Use the official public business contact route for a dispatch and fleet-workflow automation proposal.
items.buyer_or_company_evidence: Official site identifies Speed Logistics as an Al Khobar-based last-mile delivery company serving restaurants, retail brands and enterprise teams.

items.title: DSV Saudi Arabia — logistics and supply-chain operations
items.description: Large Saudi logistics operation with extensive warehousing and supply-chain activity; relevant to data integration, document automation, operational dashboards and exception handling.
items.contact_strategy: Use the official country-page contact route with a narrowly scoped integration or operational-automation proposal.
items.buyer_or_company_evidence: Official DSV country page reports 19 facilities, 274,000 square metres of warehousing and 1,200 employees in Saudi Arabia and invites tailored logistics inquiries.

items.title: Prologis Spain — logistics real-estate operations
items.description: Spanish logistics real-estate operator managing leasing, property operations and customer experience; relevant to CRM, reporting, document and workflow integration.
items.contact_strategy: Use the official Spain property-services contact route for an operations or customer-workflow automation proposal.
items.buyer_or_company_evidence: Official Spain site describes property-management and leasing teams supporting customers from initial inquiry through tenancy.

items.title: dLocal — global travel-tech payment infrastructure
items.description: Cross-border payment platform supporting travel-tech pay-ins, supplier payouts and invoice collection; relevant to backend, API, automation and monitoring engineering.

items.buyer_or_company_evidence: Official industry page describes a centralized payment platform for travel-tech pay-ins, supplier payouts and invoice collection and provides a Contact Sales route.
